t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick a random gnome, take note of the colour and the mushroom yield. If that colour yields a high mushroom yield reuse that colour before it disappears. This may not work 100%.

vb_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes is the most important factor and the value that these colors yield will change over time nut gradually. This means that for example 'blue' can be a good yield in the beginning but then be bad later in the round or in the next round. Its good to experiment with colours in rounds with  a 1x multiplier. Size and hat shape make no difference.
